name: Laya
description: Laya is Convai Innovations’ System One evaluation model for fast, structured decisions. It evaluates shared state against choice, score, and yes/no questions and returns typed answers with probabilities in a single forward pass. It supports classification, routing, guardrail checks, and rubric-based assessment without generating free-form text.

name: Laya (Free)
description: Laya is Convai Innovations’ System One evaluation model for fast, structured decisions. It evaluates shared state against choice, score, and yes/no questions and returns typed answers with probabilities in a single forward pass. It supports classification, routing, guardrail checks, and rubric-based assessment without generating free-form text.

name: Liquid d1
description: Liquid d1 is a decision model for classification, routing, and scoring. It evaluates shared state against typed Choice, Score, and yes/no questions and returns structured answers with calibrated probabilities through the TypeSafe-compatible System One API.

name: Decision-1
description: Microsoft Decision-1 is a text decision model from Microsoft AI for classification, routing, and evaluation. It answers yes/no questions, selects among predefined options, and scores inputs against custom criteria, returning calibrated probabilities and confidence values. With support for multiple questions per request and a 32,768-token context window, it helps developers triage support requests, guide automated workflows, and evaluate AI responses against a rubric.

name: GPT-6 Luna Decisions
description: GPT-6 Luna Decisions evaluates classification and scoring questions against shared text and image input using OpenAI's Decisions API. It supports predicate, choice, and score questions with probabilities and confidence values.

name: Classify-1
description: ScaleDown Classify-1 is a task-specific small language model for text classification. It assigns text to custom labels and returns probability scores, supporting intent detection, content categorization, and routing workflows. Its deterministic, encoder-only approach produces consistent classification results without sampling variability.

name: Jev
description: TypeSafe AI System One decision model. Accepts shared state and typed questions, returning choices, scores, and boolean probabilities. Limits: 64,000 tokens total per request; 32,000 tokens for the state plus the longest question. No streaming or output-token limit.
